entries.zh: 殓尸装殓，为亡者裹尸备葬（以殓布裹束遗体）；裹殓
entries.en: to prepare a dead body for burial; to shroud and encoffin the dead
entries.notes: 汉栏「脩殮」义同「收殮/入殮」，[疑:殮/襝] 字形两读但词义无碍，故按 [疑] 规则列中等置信
词头 Amotacado 疑为 amohinado/amotinado 之形变，汉栏「淺腹」非通行词形，据西栏 enojo 定为怒义

entries.zh: 打滚，翻滚（参西语 rebolar）；缠绕，扭结（樛）
entries.en: to roll about, tumble; to twist, writhe
entries.notes: [疑:樛/樓] 字形存疑；q. 为「即/参见」条目互参略语，义从 rebolar（滚转）

entries.en: to throw into disorder, stir up tumult; to foment mutiny
entries.notes: [疑:樛/樓]；西语 amotinar 本义鼓动骚乱，与「樛乱」扰攘义相合

entries.en: to rely on, depend on; to shelter and help
entries.notes: Amprar 为 amparar 略写，q. aiudas 疑指「即相助（ayuda）」义；[疑:怙/忖]

entries.en: to look after, take care of; to protect, shelter
to look after attentively; to watch over
entries.notes: 缩写 cuidand. 按 cuidando（照看着）展开依赖推断；[疑:盼/眄]

entries.en: to rely on, depend on; to shelter, protect
to explain, interpret; to release, resolve
entries.notes: 西栏末项 inuerçades 无法展开，「解釋」与 amparar/encaminar（护送、引路）互证不完全

entries.zh: 作主，当家做主；充当主人、庇主（靠山）
entries.en: to be master, take charge; to act as one's patron and protector
entries.notes: 西栏 seramo supatron 疑拆读作 ser amo / su patrón（主人、庇主），展开依赖推断

entries.en: blessing and protective shade; sheltering grace
entries.notes: 西栏 serbo 疑为 servar（守护）或 siervo 之形，展开依赖推断

entries.en: to receive shelter and protection; to be shaded within
entries.notes: serbo 展开存疑同上；汉栏「受荫」与西栏 amparad/within（居中庇护）义相合

entries.zh: 遮荫，遮蔽庇护（为其遮挡）
entries.en: to shade and shelter; to cover, protect (someone)

entries.zh: 遮拦，阻挡遮护（挺身居中代为拦挡）
entries.en: to block, screen; to shield by interposing oneself
entries.notes: [疑:欄/攔]；闽南栏音写与官话栏有出入，词义从「遮拦」居中遮挡
汉字、闽南、官话三栏皆 [空]，仅存词头 Janglian，无从释义
